# R Documentation

Use either package:

roxygenize()

devtools()

Description Tagged (using special "key" words)

Common examples: @param input/parameter description

@return

@example

@references

@author

\#' compute_NPV \### name of function

\#' ###must leave one line blank

\#' compute net present value \### description

\#' @param value/cost (\$)

\#' @param time in the future that cost/value occurs (years)

\#' @param discount rate

\#' @return value in \$

Loading another package to find documentation:

-   clone repo

-   build: load all to find them

-   help(functionname)
